source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Accepted code distinguishes extension-local name, numeric spaceId and DOM spaceButtonId. The public create schema restricts names to alphanumerics/underscores; _makeSpaceButtonId combines makeWidgetId(extension.id), the spacesButton marker and the local name. Keep those distinct names in methods, maps and docs. The current comment incorrectly describes the suffix as spaceId; a scoped documentation repair should say name. This is not a general DOM casing mandate. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.
title: Keep three space identity namespaces explicit
